an5.136:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño khattiyassa muddhābhisittassa jeṭṭho putto uparajjaṃ pattheti
an5.136:1.3: idha bhikkhave rañño khattiyassa muddhābhisittassa jeṭṭho putto ubhato sujāto hoti mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakuṭṭho jātivādena
an5.136:1.4: abhirūpo hoti dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato
an5.136:1.7: paṇḍito hoti byatto medhāvī paṭibalo atītānāgatapaccuppanne atthe cintetuṃ
an5.136:2.2: ahaṃ khomhi ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakuṭṭho jātivādena
an5.136:2.4: ahaṃ khomhi abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato
an5.136:2.10: ahaṃ khomhi paṇḍito byatto medhāvī paṭibalo atītānāgatapaccuppanne atthe cintetuṃ
an5.136:2.12: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño khattiyassa muddhābhisittassa jeṭṭho putto uparajjaṃ pattheti
an5.136:3.1: evameva kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pattheti
an5.136:3.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti …pe… sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an5.136:3.6: āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya …pe… anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu
an5.136:3.7: paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā
an5.136:4.4: ahaṃ khomhi bahussuto sutadharo sutasannicayo …pe… diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā
an5.136:4.8: ahaṃ khomhi āraddhaviriyo viharāmi akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya …pe… anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu
an5.136:4.12: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayaṃ patthetīti.
